text:
Mira: Quick thread to finalize the Harbor DP playbook: recruitment incentives, feedback routing, and launch gates. Goal: reliable signals from 4 external partners in 8 weeks.
Ike: High level ask: keep incentives simple, predictable for finance, and tie priority to partner commitment.
Mira: Draft tiers: Explorer (no credits, 2-week onboarding), Collaborator ($4k credits + office hours), Anchor ($18k credits + 40h SRE support + roadmap slot). Anchor requires a 6-week stability commitment.
Hannah: For on-prem Anchors add a $6k ops stipend for installation and a signed infra runbook acceptance. Also require a short anonymized case study for Anchor.
Rui: Intake must capture data_classification, KMS_needed (y/n), logs_allowed (y/n), and requested SLA tier. If sensitive data, flag for a security pre-review.
dp-bot: New intake published: https://console.internal/dp/harbor-intake (auto-tag: dp/harbor) :shipit:
Mira: Feedback capture: single canonical tag "dp/harbor" in console + required fields in form. On submit, dp-bot creates a triage card and optional GH issue.
Ike: Triage scoring proposal (compact):
```
score = (4 if reproducible else 0) + (2 if impact == "high" else 1 if impact == "medium" else 0) + (1 if user_visible else 0)
```
Then multiply by tier_weight: Explorer=1.0, Collaborator=1.1, Anchor=1.25. Map final score: >=7 -> P0, 5-6 -> P1, <=4 -> backlog/watch.
Hannah: Add an override for security-sensitive items: any item marked "PHI" or "PCI" auto-escalates to urgent security review.
Rui: Onboarding checklist (Anchor): Week 0 access + keys, Week 1 dataset ingest + eval prompts, Week 2 baseline metrics + e2e smoke, Week 3 stability runs + SLO verification, Week 4 optional optimization. I'll post templates.
Mira: Success criteria to remain in active cohort: by day 30 either 1) >=15 valid calls/day OR 2) daily evals run with rolling quality within 3% of baseline. If neither, auto-offer downgrade to Collaborator or Explorer.
Ike: Launch gates for partner feature: staging infra SLOs sustained 72h, no quality regressions >1.5% vs partner baseline, and partner E2E tests pass. If gate fails, we schedule a 3-day hotfix window.
Hannah: Measurement signals: regen_rate, false_positive_rate, median latency (p50/p95), daily_active_calls, and partner_nps. Store all evals with partner_id tag for later analysis.
Rui: Suggested rollout: start with 1 internal Anchor and 2 external Collaborators for first 4 weeks, then onboard 2 external Anchors staggered across weeks 5-10. Keep SRE capacity reserved: 1 SRE per Anchor onboarding.
Mira: Cost sanity check: rough monthly bucket cost per active partner: Explorer $120, Collaborator $1,000, Anchor $4,200 (includes credits and SRE amortization). Finance review required.
Ike: Action items: @Ike - ping finance for numbers; @Rui - add KMS/runbook + onboarding templates; @Hannah - security intake flow and case study template; @Mira - finalize incentive T&Cs and publish intake. Reconvene next Tue to finalize.
Rui: I'll wire up the onboarding templates by EOD tomorrow.
Hannah: Security checklist draft inbound tonight.
Ike: I'll loop in finance and Ops.
Mira: Thanks team  keep the cohorts tight and make signals actionable. :seedling:
